name: Inoue Akira
source:
Inoue is a girl in the newspaper club at [url=/c267]Kotarou’s[/url] school. She suspects that Kotarou’s bribed his way into being admitted to the school. Like Kotarou, she investigates the mysterious surrounding Kazamatsuri, and thus sees him as a rival.

While not illustrated in the game, she is later given official artwork in other media. Her official sprite appears in Harvest festa and Rewrite+.
